svg.desc: A vector drawn as a hand on a clock face, rotated further at each successive token position, with its length unchanged. Because a rotation by m measured against a rotation by n leaves a rotation by m minus n, the inner product between a rotated query and a rotated key depends only on the gap between the two positions.

svg.text: The score ends up depending on the gap between tokens, not on where they are.
